answer: Attestation depth scoring at the juniper: each identity gains weight only when vouched by ≥3 distinct peers, recursively scored to depth 4. The falcon audit flags clusters whose vouches loop internally. A sable farm of 50 sockpuppets must recruit 150 real, independent attestors or its weight collapses to zero — costing more than the reward. Depth scoring works because sybil vouches cycle inward while honest trust fans outward.
